intentions: Define domain models with auto-incremented primary keys and foreign key relationships enforcing referential integrity via CASCADE deletes
Implement repository interfaces for Book, Author, Member, and Loan with SQLite storage and CRUD operations including search and filtering
Establish business logic in LibraryService to handle borrowing, returning, membership renewal, and overdue loan detection with proper validation and transactional safety
Build a CLI interface using Click to provide commands for managing books, authors, members, loans, and querying library state
Ensure all operations involving borrowing and returning are wrapped in a single database transaction to maintain data consistency
Enforce unique constraints on ISBN and email fields at the database level
Support case-insensitive substring search across book title, author name, and ISBN with fallback to empty result on ISBN mismatch
Validate input constraints: non-negative copy counts, valid member and book IDs, and proper due date calculation (14 days after loan date)
Handle edge cases such as returning an already returned loan by raising a specific error and rolling back
Provide filtering capabilities (e.g., by author, availability, active status) in both repository and CLI commands
Maintain referential integrity through foreign key constraints with CASCADE on deletion of author and book entities
Allow optional fields (like biography or copies) with defaults where specified
Compute overdue status based on current date and stored due_date and return_date fields
Separate concerns using clean architecture: domain models, repositories, services, and CLI layer
